control.title: DPO or privacy contact published
control.description: Publish the contact details of the DPO or designated privacy person on the website and app, and include them in every response to a Data Principal.

implementation_notes: Owned by the Grievance Officer; process documented in the privacy runbook.
evidence_hint: Website or app screenshot showing contact details.
acceptance_criteria: The website or app shows the DPO or privacy contact's details

criteria_coverage.criterion: The website or app shows the DPO or privacy contact's details

requirements.title: Publish contact details for data protection queries
requirements.guidance: Publish the business contact information of the Data Protection Officer (if applicable) or a person who can answer Data Principals' questions about processing.

requirements.title: Contact details on website, app and in responses
requirements.guidance: Prominently publish the DPO's or designated person's business contact information on the website or app, and mention it in every response to a Data Principal's request.
